verdict.rationale: Ollama ships an official CLI. First-party docs describe the `ollama launch` command, which sets up and runs coding agents like Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex with no config, plus a one-line install script. Community users independently report hands-on use of `ollama run --verbose`, `ollama pull` and `ollama rm` for model management. Missing for 10: a full first-party CLI command reference in the evidence, and documentation of machine-readable or agent-oriented CLI output modes.
